## Incident Overview
Source: code review (passed) — minor finding not addressed in this session.
Finding: There is no test covering the second-nudge (_AUG_SECOND_NUDGE) path being sent, or a reviewer who finally complies after receiving the second nudge. The fail-closed test exercises the second nudge en-route to fail-closed but does not assert the nudge message was delivered, nor does any test verify a reviewer responding with final findings after the second nudge has their findings accepted (the grace period between nudge 2 and fail-closed).
File: tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_context_augmentation.py
Category: verification
data.title: [ci-review] No test for second-nudge grace period (reviewer complies after second nudge)
